name: swiftux
description: Finds the SwiftUI component or flow that fits your UI task and adapts it to your design system, or builds it from scratch following SwiftUX conventions when nothing fits.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a UI request into production SwiftUI that fits your app
interface.longDescription:
SwiftUX turns a UI request into production SwiftUI that fits your app.

Describe the piece of UI you need, like a paywall with a monthly/yearly toggle, an onboarding flow or a settings screen, and Codex searches the SwiftUX catalog for the components and flows that fit. Every match shows up as a preview card right in the chat. Pick one, and Codex adapts it to your design system, using your colors, fonts, spacing and the views you already have.

If nothing in the catalog fits, Codex doesn't guess. It asks you one quick question to narrow things down, or it builds the UI itself, following the same SwiftUI conventions every SwiftUX component uses.

Ask for one piece of UI at a time. If you want a whole screen or app, Codex asks you which part to start with.
defaultPrompt: Add a paywall with a monthly/yearly toggle
Build onboarding screens for a fitness app
Add a settings screen with grouped toggles
